description: This file defines a mock class ApplicationManagementServerMock for testing purposes, which implements the IApplicationManagementServer interface. It uses Google Mock to mock methods related to application management in an IPC context within the Rialto server project.

classes.name: ApplicationManagementServerMock
classes.description: Mock class implementing IApplicationManagementServer interface for testing application management IPC functionalities.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Mocks the initialization method which takes a socket descriptor.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Mocks the method to send a state change event with the current session server state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Mocks the method to start the application management server.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Mocks the method to stop the application management server.
